## Description

docs/compliance/threat-model.md (STRIDE per trust boundary: browser→BFF, BFF→SQL/Blob, jobs, future AI and integrations), data map (data categories, purposes, systems, country, processors/sub-processors), DPIA draft against DPDP Act + Rules (and a UAE health-data note), record-retention map per country (audio, transcripts, notes, audit, billing) with "to confirm by counsel" markers. Feed mitigations back as tickets.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Threat model covers every trust boundary in docs/03-architecture/README.md with at least one mitigation per threat and links to tickets.
- [ ] **AC2.** Data map lists every P0–P2 data category with storage location, country and processor.
- [ ] **AC3.** DPIA draft lists purposes, lawful basis/consent, data minimisation, retention and risks, with open items assigned.
- [ ] **AC4.** Retention map has a row for each data class with proposed default and legal-review status.
- [ ] **AC5.** All four documents are part of the R0 delivery package.

## Definition of Done
